phoneticConvention: Approximate respelling for English readers (CAPITALS = stressed syllable; vowels ah / eh / ee / oh / oo; c+e/i → ch, g+e/i → j, gn → ny, gl → ly, sc+e/i → sh, z → ts / dz; double consonants held longer, e.g. kaf-FEH). No substitute for the audio.

title: Plans and suggestions
goal: Talk about plans, suggest and organise an activity.

variants.native: I'm planning to change jobs.
I'm planning to learn Italian.

variants.study: Ho intenzione di andare in Italia.
variants.phon: oh een-tehn-TSYOH-neh dee ahn-DAH-reh een ee-TAH-lyah
variants.native: I'm planning to go to Italy.

variants.study: Ho intenzione di comprare una casa.
variants.phon: oh een-tehn-TSYOH-neh dee kohm-PRAH-reh OO-nah KAH-zah
variants.native: I'm planning to buy a house.
Tomorrow I'll go to Rome.
Tomorrow I'll work from home.
Tomorrow I'll see my friends.
Tomorrow I'll leave early.
Could we go to the cinema?
Could we have dinner together?
Could we meet tomorrow?
Could we have a coffee?

model.note: Informal "tu". With a stranger: "Le va di…?" (leh vah dee).

variants.native: Do you feel like going out tonight?

variants.study: Ti va di venire con noi?
variants.phon: tee vah dee veh-NEE-reh kohn NOY
variants.native: Do you feel like coming with us?

variants.study: Ti va di fare una passeggiata?
variants.phon: tee vah dee FAH-reh OO-nah pahs-sehd-JAH-tah
variants.native: Do you feel like going for a walk?

variants.study: Ti va di andare al concerto?
variants.phon: tee vah dee ahn-DAH-reh ahl kohn-CHEHR-toh
variants.native: Do you feel like going to the concert?

model.native: So, {s} in front of the station.

variants.study: Allora, sabato alle dieci davanti alla stazione.
variants.phon: ahl-LOH-rah, SAH-bah-toh AHL-leh DYEH-chee dah-VAHN-tee AHL-lah stah-TSYOH-neh
variants.native: So, Saturday at ten in front of the station.

variants.study: Allora, domani alle sei davanti alla stazione.
variants.phon: ahl-LOH-rah, doh-MAH-nee AHL-leh SEH-ee dah-VAHN-tee AHL-lah stah-TSYOH-neh
variants.native: So, tomorrow at six in front of the station.

variants.study: Allora, stasera alle otto davanti alla stazione.
variants.phon: ahl-LOH-rah, stah-SEH-rah AHL-leh OHT-toh dah-VAHN-tee AHL-lah stah-TSYOH-neh
variants.native: So, tonight at eight in front of the station.

variants.study: Allora, domenica a mezzogiorno davanti alla stazione.
variants.phon: ahl-LOH-rah, doh-MEH-nee-kah ah mehd-dzoh-JOR-noh dah-VAHN-tee AHL-lah stah-TSYOH-neh
variants.native: So, Sunday at noon in front of the station.

variants.study: Non posso, ma possiamo vederci domani.
variants.phon: nohn POHS-soh, mah pohs-SYAH-moh veh-DEHR-chee doh-MAH-nee
variants.native: I can't, but we can meet tomorrow.

variants.study: Non posso, ma posso venire più tardi.
variants.phon: nohn POHS-soh, mah POHS-soh veh-NEE-reh pyoo TAR-dee
variants.native: I can't, but I can come later.

variants.study: Non posso, ma ti chiamo stasera.
variants.phon: nohn POHS-soh, mah tee KYAH-moh stah-SEH-rah
variants.native: I can't, but I'll call you tonight.

variants.study: Non posso, ma la prossima volta sì.
variants.phon: nohn POHS-soh, mah lah PROHS-see-mah VOHL-tah SEE
variants.native: I can't, but next time, yes.
I'd like to visit Naples.
I'd like to live in Italy.
I'd like to come with you.
I'd like to see the sea.
So we're on for Saturday?

variants.study: Allora siamo d'accordo per domani sera?
variants.phon: ahl-LOH-rah SYAH-moh dahk-KOR-doh pehr doh-MAH-nee SEH-rah
variants.native: So we're on for tomorrow evening?

variants.study: Allora siamo d'accordo per le dieci?
variants.phon: ahl-LOH-rah SYAH-moh dahk-KOR-doh pehr leh DYEH-chee
variants.native: So we're on for ten o'clock?

variants.study: Allora siamo d'accordo per il pranzo di domenica?
variants.phon: ahl-LOH-rah SYAH-moh dahk-KOR-doh pehr eel PRAHN-tsoh dee doh-MEH-nee-kah
variants.native: So we're on for Sunday lunch?
Why don't we go to the seaside?
Why don't we eat out?
Why don't we take the train?
Why don't we stay at home?
I want to learn to cook.
I want to go on a trip.
I want to rest a bit.
I want to find a new job.

variants.study: La prossima settimana avrò una riunione.
variants.phon: lah PROHS-see-mah seht-tee-MAH-nah ah-VROH OO-nah ryoo-NYOH-neh
variants.native: Next week I'll have a meeting.

variants.study: La prossima settimana sarò a Milano.
variants.phon: lah PROHS-see-mah seht-tee-MAH-nah sah-ROH ah mee-LAH-noh
variants.native: Next week I'll be in Milan.

variants.study: La prossima settimana inizierò il nuovo lavoro.
variants.phon: lah PROHS-see-mah seht-tee-MAH-nah ee-nee-tsyeh-ROH eel NWOH-voh lah-VOH-roh
variants.native: Next week I'll start the new job.

variants.study: La prossima settimana saremo in vacanza.
variants.phon: lah PROHS-see-mah seht-tee-MAH-nah sah-REH-moh een vah-KAHN-tsah
variants.native: Next week we'll be on holiday.
I'm taking the eight o'clock train.
I'm taking the eight o'clock bus.
I'm taking the eight o'clock flight.
I'm taking the eight o'clock metro.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Ti va di fare qualcosa sabato?
turns.phon: tee vah dee FAH-reh kwahl-KOH-zah SAH-bah-toh
turns.native: Do you feel like doing something on Saturday?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Sì! Potremmo andare al mare?
turns.phon: SEE. poh-TREHM-moh ahn-DAH-reh ahl MAH-reh
turns.native: Yes! Could we go to the seaside?

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Sabato non posso, ma domenica sì.
turns.phon: SAH-bah-toh nohn POHS-soh, mah doh-MEH-nee-kah SEE
turns.native: I can't on Saturday, but Sunday is fine.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Va bene, domenica. A che ora?
turns.phon: vah BEH-neh, doh-MEH-nee-kah. ah keh OH-rah
turns.native: OK, Sunday. What time?

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Alle nove davanti alla stazione? Prendiamo il treno delle nove e venti.
turns.phon: AHL-leh NOH-veh dah-VAHN-tee AHL-lah stah-TSYOH-neh. prehn-DYAH-moh eel TREH-noh DEHL-leh NOH-veh eh VEHN-tee
turns.native: Nine o'clock in front of the station? We'll take the 9:20 train.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Perfetto. Porto io i panini.
turns.phon: pehr-FEHT-toh. POR-toh EE-oh ee pah-NEE-nee
turns.native: Perfect. I'll bring the sandwiches.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Ottimo! Allora siamo d'accordo per domenica alle nove.
turns.phon: OHT-tee-moh. ahl-LOH-rah SYAH-moh dahk-KOR-doh pehr doh-MEH-nee-kah AHL-leh NOH-veh
turns.native: Great! So we're on for Sunday at nine.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Sì, ti chiamo sabato sera per confermare.
turns.phon: SEE, tee KYAH-moh SAH-bah-toh SEH-rah pehr kohn-fehr-MAH-reh
turns.native: Yes, I'll call you Saturday evening to confirm.

dialogues.practice: Listen to both roles, hide one role, answer, then swap one line for a variant of your own.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Buongiorno, dottoressa Rossi. Potremmo vederci la prossima settimana?
turns.phon: bwohn-JOR-noh, doht-toh-REHS-sah ROHS-see. poh-TREHM-moh veh-DEHR-chee lah PROHS-see-mah seht-tee-MAH-nah
turns.native: Good morning, Dr Rossi. Could we meet next week?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Certo. Martedì mattina va bene?
turns.phon: CHEHR-toh. mar-teh-DEE maht-TEE-nah vah BEH-neh
turns.native: Of course. Does Tuesday morning suit you?

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Martedì sarò a Milano. Mercoledì?
turns.phon: mar-teh-DEE sah-ROH ah mee-LAH-noh. mehr-koh-leh-DEE
turns.native: On Tuesday I'll be in Milan. Wednesday?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Mercoledì alle dieci, nel mio ufficio.
turns.phon: mehr-koh-leh-DEE AHL-leh DYEH-chee, nehl MEE-oh oof-FEE-choh
turns.native: Wednesday at ten, in my office.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Perfetto. Le mando una mail per confermare.
turns.phon: pehr-FEHT-toh. leh MAHN-doh OO-nah MAYL pehr kohn-fehr-MAH-reh
turns.native: Perfect. I'll send you an email to confirm.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Grazie. Ha intenzione di presentare il nuovo progetto?
turns.phon: GRAH-tsyeh. ah een-tehn-TSYOH-neh dee preh-zehn-TAH-reh eel NWOH-voh proh-JEHT-toh
turns.native: Thank you. Are you planning to present the new project?

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Sì, e mi piacerebbe avere la Sua opinione.
turns.phon: SEE, eh mee pyah-cheh-REHB-beh ah-VEH-reh lah SOO-ah oh-pee-NYOH-neh
turns.native: Yes, and I'd like to have your opinion.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Volentieri. A mercoledì, allora.
turns.phon: voh-lehn-TYEH-ree. ah mehr-koh-leh-DEE, ahl-LOH-rah
turns.native: Gladly. See you Wednesday, then.

dialogues.practice: Listen to both roles, hide one role, answer, then swap one line for a variant of your own.

dialogues.situation: At the station: change of plan (phone, tu)

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Pronto, Sara? Sono alla stazione, ma il treno è in ritardo.
turns.phon: PROHN-toh, SAH-rah. SOH-noh AHL-lah stah-TSYOH-neh, mah eel TREH-noh eh een ree-TAR-doh
turns.native: Hello, Sara? I'm at the station, but the train is late.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Oh no! Di quanto?
turns.phon: oh NOH. dee KWAHN-toh
turns.native: Oh no! How late?

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Di un'ora. Arriverò verso le nove.
turns.phon: dee oo-NOH-rah. ar-ree-veh-ROH VEHR-soh leh NOH-veh
turns.native: An hour. I'll get there around nine.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Non c'è problema. Ti aspetto al ristorante.
turns.phon: nohn cheh proh-BLEH-mah. tee ahs-PEHT-toh ahl rees-toh-RAHN-teh
turns.native: No problem. I'll wait for you at the restaurant.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Perché non prendiamo qualcosa dopo, invece? Una pizza vicino a casa tua?
turns.phon: pehr-KEH nohn prehn-DYAH-moh kwahl-KOH-zah DOH-poh, een-VEH-cheh. OO-nah PEET-tsah vee-CHEE-noh ah KAH-zah TOO-ah
turns.native: Why don't we grab something afterwards instead? A pizza near your place?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Buona idea. Allora ci vediamo alle nove e mezza davanti a casa mia.
turns.phon: BWOH-nah ee-DEH-ah. ahl-LOH-rah chee veh-DYAH-moh AHL-leh NOH-veh eh MEHD-dzah dah-VAHN-tee ah KAH-zah MEE-ah
turns.native: Good idea. So see you at half past nine in front of my place.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Perfetto, a dopo!
turns.phon: pehr-FEHT-toh, ah DOH-poh
turns.native: Perfect, see you later!

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: A dopo, buon viaggio!
turns.phon: ah DOH-poh, bwohn VYAHD-joh
turns.native: See you later, safe trip!

dialogues.practice: Listen to both roles, hide one role, answer, then swap one line for a variant of your own.

readiness: Talk about your plans in the future, suggest an activity, set a place and a time, decline while offering an alternative, and confirm an arrangement.
